entities.name: Gulsum Asfendiyarova
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gülsim Jafarqyzy Asfendiarova was the first Kazakh woman to earn a medical degree. She played a key role in organizing the healthcare system in the Turkestan region and was also a dedicated medical educator.
